description: NaNbO₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.87 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-21°. There are two shorter (2.01 Å) and four longer (2.02 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms.
